enforceCapacity.name: Enforce Capacity Limit
enforceCapacity.hint: When enabled, the inventory respects a weight limit. Default 500 lbs matches a Bag of Holding. Disable for unlimited capacity.

capacityLimit.name: Capacity Limit (lbs)
capacityLimit.hint: Weight cap when 'Enforce Capacity Limit' is enabled. The Bag of Holding standard is 500.

applyCurrencyWeight.name: Currency Counts Toward Weight
applyCurrencyWeight.hint: When enabled, currency weight is included in the capacity total. Built-in currencies use the dnd5e standard of 50 coins per pound; custom currencies use their optional per-unit weight. Off by default.

currencyApprovalMode.name: Currency Approval Mode
currencyApprovalMode.hint: Controls whether GM approval is required when players change shared currency values.

currencyApprovalThreshold.name: Approval Threshold (Reference Currency)
currencyApprovalThreshold.hint: When mode is 'Threshold', changes equal to or above this value require GM approval. Currency changes are converted into the reference currency selected in Manage Currencies.

useApprovalTimeout.name: Use Approval Timeout
useApprovalTimeout.hint: When enabled, pending currency approval requests auto-approve after the specified time if the GM does not respond.

approvalTimeoutSeconds.name: Approval Timeout (seconds)
approvalTimeoutSeconds.hint: Time before a pending approval auto-approves, when timeout is enabled.

denialNotification.name: Denial Notification Scope
denialNotification.hint: When the GM denies a currency request, who sees the denial chat message.

reasonFieldEnabled.name: Show Reason Field on Requests
reasonFieldEnabled.hint: When enabled, players can optionally include a reason when requesting a currency change.

resendCooldownSeconds.name: Resend Cooldown (seconds)
resendCooldownSeconds.hint: How long a player must wait before re-sending an approval request to the GM.

unidentifiedDisplay.name: Unidentified Item Display
unidentifiedDisplay.hint: How items marked unidentified appear in the inventory.

inventoryButtonLabel.name: Inventory Button Name
inventoryButtonLabel.hint: Custom name shown for the inventory button and popup window. Leave blank to use the default.

inventoryBackgroundImage.name: Inventory Background Image
inventoryBackgroundImage.hint: Optional image shown as a subtle watermark inside the inventory popup.

hidePricesFromPlayers.name: Hide Item Prices from Players
hidePricesFromPlayers.hint: When enabled, item prices are hidden from players in the inventory. GMs still see prices.

enableInventoryToken.name: Enable Inventory Token Shortcut
enableInventoryToken.hint: When enabled, GMs can place a scene token that opens the inventory when double-clicked.

inventoryTokenName.name: Inventory Token Name
inventoryTokenName.hint: Optional name for newly placed inventory shortcut tokens. Leave blank to use the inventory button name.

inventoryTokenImage.name: Inventory Token Image
inventoryTokenImage.hint: Optional image for newly placed inventory shortcut tokens. Leave blank to use the Quartermaster Vault image.

defaultEntrySize.name: Default Entry Size
defaultEntrySize.hint: Default row size in the inventory. Each player can override via client settings.

sortOrder.name: Default Sort Order
sortOrder.hint: Order in which currencies, counters, and items appear in the list.

hideZeroBalances.name: Hide Currencies at Zero
hideZeroBalances.hint: When enabled, currencies with a balance of zero are hidden until they have value.

transactionLogCap.name: Transaction Log Cap
transactionLogCap.hint: Maximum number of log entries retained. Older entries are trimmed when the cap is reached. Set to 0 for unlimited.

transactionLogVisibility.name: Transaction Log Visibility
transactionLogVisibility.hint: Who can open and view the transaction log.

requestAgeMaxSeconds.name: Request Age Max (seconds)
requestAgeMaxSeconds.hint: Reject socket requests older than this many seconds. Protects against replay storms after reconnects. Default 30 is appropriate for typical tables.

recentRequestCacheSize.name: Recent Request Cache Size
recentRequestCacheSize.hint: Maximum number of recent request IDs held in memory for fast idempotency checks. Larger values use slightly more RAM but reduce duplicate database lookups. Default 5000 is generous.

uiRefreshDebounceMs.name: UI Refresh Debounce (ms)
uiRefreshDebounceMs.hint: Time window for collapsing rapid backing-actor updates into a single popup re-render. Higher values smooth out bulk operations at the cost of slight visual lag. 100 ms is the v0.5 default; set to 0 to disable debouncing.

logDefaultPhaseFilter.name: Default Phase Filter
logDefaultPhaseFilter.hint: Phase filter selected when the Transaction Log opens.

logDefaultCategoryFilter.name: Default Category Filter
logDefaultCategoryFilter.hint: Category filter selected when the Transaction Log opens.

logAutoExpandGroups.name: Auto-expand Groups
logAutoExpandGroups.hint: Expand all log entry groups when the Transaction Log opens.

hideElectrum.name: Hide Electrum
hideElectrum.hint: Remove Electrum (EP) from the currency display.

currencyApprovalMode.threshold: Threshold — approval over a set amount
currencyApprovalMode.allRequired: All Required — approval for every change

sortOrder.currencyFirst: Currencies first, then counters, then items

messages.backingActorMissing: Quartermaster backing actor not found. It will be created on next world load.
